record.edic_text:
105 aetos {ah-et-os'}

from the same as 109;; n m

AV - eagle 4; 4

1) an eagle: since eagles do not usually go in quest of carrion,
   this may to a vulture that resembles an eagle
2) an eagle as a standard (Roman Military)
